criteria.description: One content-height section/container/copy/h1/description/action group/image and exactly two CTA anchors; zero form/dialog/video/overlay/nav/logo/third CTA
Copy appears before image in one column through 1023px; image left and copy right in two centered columns from 1024px
Exactly two CTA anchors wrap naturally and stay touch-safe without overflow
One owned image has meaningful alt/intrinsic dimensions, covers a rounded frame, and never overflows
No overlap, clipping, or horizontal overflow at 320/390/767/1023/1024/1280; section remains content-height
Distinct real destinations, visible focus, 44px targets, axe AA, light/dark contrast, reduced motion, logical DOM/focus order
Single DOM tree, both destinations, and image remain usable without JavaScript
Fresh matrix awaits independent Codex review
